summary: CICS online Main Menu for regular users. Displays the list of available options (account view/update, card list/view/update, transaction list/view/add, bill pay, reports, etc.), validates the option the user selects, and transfers control (CICS XCTL) to the corresponding program. Pseudo-conversational; the menu options are driven by a shared menu-definition copybook.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the main menu. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 sign off (return to sign-on); Enter process the selected option. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the entered option number: it must be numeric and within the range of available menu options; if invalid, show an error. If valid, look up the target program for that option and transfer control to it (XCTL), passing the user context.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: menu option must be numeric and within the valid option range; selection transfers to the mapped program.

paragraphs.name: SEND-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and the menu option list and send the menu map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the menu map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build the displayable list of menu options from the menu-definition copybook (option number + description).

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, ids).

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Sign the user off by transferring control back to the sign-on program.
